skill2: ■ Affects 2 allies with the highest final ATK. Damage Taken ▼ 28.65% for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ S1 trigger: kit says "Activates when attacked 20 time(s)" — an INCOMING-hit counter the sim has no channel for (the scope-lock boss's attack cadence on this unit is unmodeled). Encoded as interval:20s as a stand-in; the real re-fire cadence is UNMEASURED and the 20s duration means uptime is ~100% if the boss lands 20 hits per 20s and much lower if not.

⚑ S1 stat routing: "Charge Damage Multiplier ▲" is read as chargeDamageMultPct (scales BASE charge damage, the multiplier lane), NOT the additive chargeDamagePct lane. Wording match is on "Multiplier"; unconfirmed against a popup.

S2 Damage Taken ▼ on ALLIES is a defensive mitigation — no HP pool at scope lock, so it is offensively inert; kept as an empty-effect block so the target set (2 highest FINAL ATK allies) stays auditable, and listed in unmodeled verbatim. Note damageTakenPct in the schema is the BOSS-side debuff (positive = boss takes more); an ally-side incoming-damage reduction is a different sign and a different consumer, so it is NOT encoded with that stat.
Burst is keyed to burstCast (this unit's own Burst II cast), not fullBurstEnter — the block sits in her own burst slot with no "entering Full Burst" clause.
note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Admi (SR/Wind/Supporter/Burst II) is a pure buffer: no self damage lines, no weapon swap, no DoT, no stacks. S1 grants an all-ally Charge Damage Multiplier ▲9.59%/20s off an incoming-hit counter (⚑ stand-in trigger).
